# comlaude_dns_record (Resource)

Manages a single DNS resource record in a zone. **If the zone is active, every change here is delegated to live DNS.** Names are written relative to the zone (`"www"`), with `"@"` for the zone apex; the `fqdn` attribute carries the fully qualified form the API uses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "comlaude_domain" "main" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "comlaude_dns_record" "www" {
  zone_id = data.comlaude_domain.main.active_zone_id
  name    = "www" # relative to the zone; "@" for the apex
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 3600
  value   = "192.0.2.10"
}

resource "comlaude_dns_record" "mx" {
  zone_id  = data.comlaude_domain.main.active_zone_id
  name     = "@"
  type     = "MX"
  ttl      = 3600
  value    = "mail.example.com"
  priority = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone (`"www"`), or `"@"` for the apex.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds (1–604800).
- `type` (String) Record type: A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, DS, NS, PTR, TXT, MX, MXDUMMY, SRV.
- `value` (String) Record value; format depends on the type.
- `zone_id` (String) Zone holding the record. Typically `data.comlaude_domain.x.active_zone_id`.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (Number) Only for DS; one of 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16.
- `digest_type` (Number) Only for DS; 1, 2 or 4.
- `flags` (Number) Only for CAA; 0 or 128.
- `group_id` (String) Group the zone belongs to. Defaults to the provider's group.
- `key_tag` (Number) Only for DS; 0–99999.
- `port` (Number) Only for SRV.
- `priority` (Number) Only for MX, MXDUMMY, SRV.
- `tag` (String) Only for CAA.
- `weight` (Number) Only for SRV.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified record name as the API stores it.
- `id` (String) Record id.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether Com Laude has locked the record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import comlaude_dns_record.www <group_id>/<zone_id>/<record_id>
```
